description: emulateapj (CTAN, 2025/02/19; MiKTeX package emulateapj), the ApJ two-column look built on REVTeX, two columns by default. The revtex4 option makes it load REVTeX 4.0 straight away. That is MiKTeX's revtex4 package, v4.0a 2020/09/30, which is patched for the 2020-10 kernel. MiKTeX has no revtex4-1, so the class's \IfFileExists{revtex4-1.cls} would fall back to the same file anyway. The preamble is empty: \journalinfo, \submitted and the running heads have defaults, and an author with no \affiliation only gives a warning. Its preamble takes four of aastex.json's lines, each checked against MiKTeX's revtex4.cls: the float end with ltxgrid's vertical-mode case (REVTeX 4.0's own \end@@float at l.2493 lacks it), \@mkpream@relax relaxing \@endpbox, \switch@array relaxed (the "Extra \or" in array tables), and the contents names. Not aastex's footnote line: it needs \set@footnotefont, which REVTeX 4.0 does not have. The last line undoes ltcaption's longtable* right after caption loads it, so REVTeX's longtable patch at \begin{document} can define it ("Command \longtable* already defined" in every cell that loaded caption, first batch 2 run).
